Sees everything: events, settlements, the band fund and the history. Changes nothing. For a manager, an accountant or anyone who checks but doesn’t play.

Sees only the events they play (details and who plays), their own costs, what they receive and the band members’ names. Adds their own costs, which a leader refunds at an event. Never holds money; may settle together with another member.

Sees everything: events, settlements, the band fund and the history. Adds and edits their own costs, records money they received at events they play, and settles transfers in which they pay or receive money (and takes back ones they recorded). The band fund’s holder keeps its entries.

Everything a member can, plus: creates and edits events, participants, guests and shares, decides on cost refunds and the band fund, corrects anyone's costs and received money, settles whole events, manages band members, roles and invites, unlinks app accounts, and chooses who holds the band fund.
